blocks.text: Alexandra Eala booked her place in the final 16 of the Prudential Hong Kong Tennis Open, defeating the Australian teenager Emerson Jones in straight sets, 6-4, 6-3. Jones, 18, stepped into the round of 32 to replace the American player Alycia Parks, who withdrew to recover from a shoulder injury. Jones is currently ranked No. 132 by the Women’s Tennis Association (WTA). But against the Filipina, who has just reached her career-high ranking of No. 17, the so-called lucky loser’s luck quickly ran out. Eala wrapped up the match in one hour and 23 minutes.
